create_fov_perspective_cameras: create a batch of FoVPerspectiveCameras with specified field of view, znear, and zfar parameters
create_perspective_cameras: create a batch of PerspectiveCameras with focal length and principal point in NDC or screen space
transform_points_to_ndc: transform 3D world points to normalized device coordinates using a camera object
unproject_points_to_world: unproject 2D screen points with depth back to 3D world coordinates using a camera
compute_look_at_view_transform: compute rotation and translation matrices for a look-at camera view transform from spherical angles
